suspects.description: Primitive-pointer cast hiding struct field walk — retype to element type

Pointer value `&CStack_b8` truncated by cast to `int` (sub-pointer width) — correct on the 32-bit matching build, a hard `cast from pointer to smaller type` error at 64-bit. If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.
